from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
class Check(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self):
  super().__init__(); self.ids=[]; self.hrefs=[]; self.stack=[]; self.h1=0; self.plans=0; self.details=0
 def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
  a=dict(attrs)
  if 'id' in a: self.ids.append(a['id'])
  if tag=='a': self.hrefs.append(a.get('href',''))
  if tag=='h1': self.h1+=1
  if tag=='article': self.plans+=1
  if tag=='details': self.details+=1
  if tag not in ['meta','br','path','circle','rect','input','link','hr','img']: self.stack.append(tag)
 def handle_endtag(self, tag):
  assert self.stack and self.stack[-1]==tag, (tag, self.stack)
  self.stack.pop()
p=Check(); text=Path('index.html').read_text(); p.feed(text)
assert not p.stack
assert len(p.ids)==len(set(p.ids))
assert p.h1==1 and p.plans==3 and p.details==3
assert all(h[1:] in p.ids for h in p.hrefs if h.startswith('#') and len(h)>1)
assert '<html lang=\"en\">' in text and 'name=\"viewport\"' in text
assert 'prefers-reduced-motion' in text and ':focus-visible' in text
print('PASS: HTML nesting, unique IDs, section links, three plans, three FAQs, page language, viewport, focus and reduced-motion styles.')
PY"
